support_obstruction.conclusion: The declared candidate-13 bounded/smooth receiver and its modewise inverses cannot themselves be differentials or homotopies in a support-local finite-rank bundle complex.
support_obstruction.lemma: A nonzero projector onto a global constant or harmonic mode cannot be support-nonincreasing: a section supported in a proper open set can have nonzero mode pairing, while its projected mode is nonzero outside that set.
support_obstruction.spatial_witness: On closed S1 x S2, choose chi supported in a proper chart and a target harmonic phi with integral chi |phi|^2 nonzero; Pi_phi(chi phi) is a global multiple of phi.
support_obstruction.temporal_witness: The zero-frequency mean of a compactly supported time test function with nonzero integral is a nonzero constant and therefore has all-time support.
